title: World Bloom — All Ways Jump! With You — Episode10 Take My Hand Once More

meta.Episode: Episode10 — Take My Hand Once More
meta.Event Outline: Just when MORE MORE JUMP! has settled in to their lives as Lumina Grand Prix contestants, they notice something wrong with the tree in their SEKAI. Before they know it, the girls find themselves in a world where the four of them never met.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I never imagined we'd get to go home together one day, Haruka! I've probably used up a lifetime's worth of luck!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm just a regular high schooler now...
So, let's keep doing this when we can.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? My agency just sent me a message.
“Important Announcement”...? What could this be about?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, messages like that are often urgent. Feel free to take a look at it now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: “As previously reported, Ms. Yui Suzuki, who is a select member, will be moving on to greener pastures next month.”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: “Therefore, we will be holding an audition for a new select member.”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: An audition to become a select member...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Does that mean you have a chance to fill her spot?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If I manage to get it, then I'll get more offers for work and be able to do shows in front of more people...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: In other words, it's a chance for me to spread more hope!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I have to get it no matter what...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I have to think that she's been through a lot considering how long she said it's been since she debuted.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It's hard not to feel happy when you might have a chance to perform on stage more.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Things might get tough if she ends up becoming an important member of her group. But...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll do just fine, Minori...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm certain that you'll be able to spread hope to lots of people.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I'm not sure I deserve to be told such kind words by you...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But thanks! Starting today, I'm gonna practice more and more, and absolutely seize this opportunity!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <...and they're gonna hold an audition soon!>

rows.Speaker: Airi's Message
rows.Line: <That's great! You're definitely gonna get it!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, she already replied!
Hehe... <I promise to do my best!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hm? Why did Hinomori send a stamp saying “Good Evening”? Did she choose it by accident?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <So, can I ask you two for a tiny favor?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Why's a group call starting all of a sudden? A-Anyway, I should join!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Oh, hey. Sorry for starting a call so suddenly. I thought talking would be faster than typing.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Yes, I really appreciate it since my phone and I don't exactly get along...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Anyway, Minori, you wanted to ask us for a favor?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
<Oh, that's right...!
You don't have to if you don't feel comfortable...!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <You're really good at singing and dancing, Momoi, and Hinomori, you know how to strike pretty poses and maintain beautiful expressions!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Since you've both been doing this longer than me, I feel like I'll be able to take a step closer to the idol that I wanna become with your help.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<Yeah! You really helped cheer me up...
And it's an idol's job to cheer on those who are trying their best!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <But you better prepare yourself because I'm not gonna go easy on you!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Of course! I promise to do my best!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <I don't know how much I'll be able to help, but I'd also like to lend you a hand.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Then, let's decide when we're gonna meet!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Right... I usually work on the weekends, so during the week would be preferable.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <During the week... Oh, I know where we can practice!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, Momoi and Hinomori aren't here yet...
Did I come up a little too early...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: In that case, to ensure that they see me in my best condition, I'll start warming up right now!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wh-What are you doing up here?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Why does this scene feel so familiar...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, you said that you'd be practicing up on the rooftop, so I decided to bring you a little gift.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Here's what I brought.
Some drinks and jellies with citric acid that they were selling at the school store.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow, thanks so much...! I promise to treasure these forever!!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Umm... Please make sure to actually eat them. I hope they help you stay hydrated.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting, Minori!
Homeroom really dragged on... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's been so long. You've been really busy working as a model.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What is Haruka Kiritani doing here?
Wait a second. Are you also here to watch Minori practice?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, I was just bringing her a little gift after hearing that she'd be auditioning soon.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Since you're here, why don't you also help?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori's gonna need as many coaches as she can get if she's gonna succeed in that audition.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And you count as a hundred since you're THE Haruka Kiritani, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
I can't really dance anymore because it's been so long.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I could help by recording videos and playing music for you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I have some free time since I'm not doing any volunteer work today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks...!
With you helping out, I'll feel even more motivated while I practice!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so glad for you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, let's get right to it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! Thank you all for doing this!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Five, six, seven, pose!
That's how it goes. What do you think...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, there's nothing wrong with the routine itself, but your presentation could use a little work.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. The best part about the way you dance is how it's always clear that you're trying extremely hard to spread hope.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But that charm will go to waste if each individual move looks bit unpolished. So, let's work on that!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That should allow you to get the crowd to focus more on you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really! I'm gonna show you a trick right now that's gonna make you look unbelievably cute!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Huh? I feel like I've said that exact same thing before...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(No, that can't be possible.
This is my first time teaching Minori anything.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think angles are important for this part of the routine. Your silhouette will look much better if you really get them right.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's go over them together and gradually make adjustments, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Would you mind if I jumped in, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I also have a habit of becoming a bit careless when performing these sorts of little movements. I'd like to take this opportunity to learn what to do.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Airi... Yes, of course.
In that case, the three of us can work on it together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Hehe. This feels a little strange since she was the one who was teaching me everything when we were still trainees.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I'm also happy that I can use what I've learned up until now to help her and Minori like this.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Huh? Where have I felt this sensation before...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Anyway, here we go. One, two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (All I can do is cheer them on.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That was good! I think she's improved a lot, no?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. Compared to when we began, you look much more charming.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you very much...!
I think I have a much better understanding of how I should be presenting myself because of you two!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, why don't we finish things off by having you perform the whole song from the top?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, before we do that, maybe it would be a good idea to check her positioning as well?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Good idea. I think we got the gist of it while teaching her, so let's join her.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What...?! Does that mean you and Hinomori are gonna dance with me, Momoi?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Again, you're the star, so do your best not to get overshadowed by us!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
E-Eep...
I must be dreaming...!
I promise to do my absolute best!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! H-Haruka, you're gonna be the audience?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That'd be lovely. We'll be motivated to do better if we know that we have someone watching.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka's gonna watch me sing and dance... That feels so strange to say.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Especially because I was always the one watching and receiving hope from your performances.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I want to take this opportunity to thank you by giving you the best dance I can! Watch me, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Anyway, I'll start the song.
Three, two, one...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (She's applying what we taught her, and she's dancing with both power and precision.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Alright, let's see how things unfold from here.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Wow... Even during the parts that I never really gave much thought while dancing, I really feel like I'm doing this to spread hope.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I have Momoi and Hinomori to thank for showing me how to really move my body.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I'm still nowhere near the idol that you were, and I still feel like giving up from time to time...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(But the way you were so dazzling...
And the hope you gave me is still there inside me.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (My dream is rekindled every time I think about that. It's why I'm standing here right now.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (So, if I can give back even just a little bit...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I want to give you hope this time!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (She's using my techniques and paying attention to angles and the direction of her face the way Shizuku showed her... She's using everything we taught her to put her charm on full display.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I can feel it dancing next to her...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Her genuine drive to show Haruka hope for a better tomorrow.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (In that case, as an idol, I can't let her keep hogging the spotlight!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Right...
I also used to dance like this when I was still performing on stage.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (My thoughts and feelings from back then still linger inside of me...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (And put them into my singing and dancing!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm hearing their message loud and clear.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (No, I shouldn't try to do anything foolish.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (For now, I should just enjoy this performance.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Even though I'm dancing with Momoi and Hinomori for the very first time...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(I know exactly what they're thinking.
Like when they want to step out in front or when they're giving me the stage...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (It's like we've been doing this forever.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(But, for some reason...
I feel like we're missing something...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (A big source of motivation and excitement.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Someone who keeps finding ways to make us shine even brighter.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hey, Haruka! Would you join us on stage?
The view from up here is beautiful!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: In that case, grab my hand!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So, Haruka, let's do this!
Let's give this show everything we have!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Haruka, what do you want to do?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Right now, I want to take her hand.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Look at that. You can still dance.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, I really thought that I couldn't anymore...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I feel like the four of us can...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The four of us have done this countless times. We can perform on stage together endlessly.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That explains why everything felt so familiar.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah...
The four of us have been dancing together basically forever.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hmm... The last thing I remember was us being in SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Did SEKAI make us have another dream?
Remember what happened when we touched the flowers of hope...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Say, everyone?
Why don't we all do another song?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I also wanna keep dancing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No one's here to watch us, but let's put on the best show that we can.
